characterization_methods: Time of flight elastic recoil detection analysis (TOF-ERDA)
evidence: The ﬁlm morphology of the ﬁlms was examined using a Zeiss DSM 962 scanning electron microscope (SEM), and the ﬁlm composition and thickness were analyzed with a Link ISIS energy dispersive x-ray (EDX) spectrometer installed to the SEM. Time of ﬂight elastic recoil detection analysis (TOF-ERDA) was used for depth proﬁling the ﬁlm constituents. The sheet resistances were measured by the four point technique. The ﬁlm crystallinity was analyzed by a Philips MPD 1880 powder x-ray diffractometer (XRD).
